## Context
Import help still describes duplicate creation and future batching. ADR 0039 and `cold-stall-chalk` delivered an import-only batching carveout, deferred push, and source-based resumption. The current implementation does not provide whole-file atomicity or automatic repair for every partial import.

## Plan
- Update canonical import parser help before generated artifacts.
- Document 256-event chunks for independent create, parent, file-impact or verify-command, and comment passes.
- State that link and status passes remain per-event.
- Document deferred push after successful import work.
- Document serial `source_id` skipping, incomplete-ticket risk after a crash between passes, and concurrent duplicate risk when scans race.
- Regenerate packaged import help, overview help, and the CLI reference.
- Correct `docs/import-export.md` without changing importer behavior.
- Add focused behavioral assertions for generated help and recovery guidance.

## Testing
- Run `python scripts/gen_cli_help.py --check` to verify packaged and overview help are regenerated from canonical parser help.
- Run `python scripts/gen_cli_reference.py --check` to verify the external CLI reference is regenerated from canonical parser help.
- Run `python -m pytest tests/unit/test_gen_cli_help.py tests/unit/test_gen_cli_reference.py -q` for the focused help-generator and import-documentation contracts.
- Run `make lint` and `make typecheck` for source checks.
- Inspect the final diff to confirm that no importer runtime module changed.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Canonical import help describes current batching behavior.
- [x] Canonical import help describes deferred-push behavior.
- [x] `python scripts/gen_cli_help.py --check` confirms packaged help matches the canonical source.
- [x] `python scripts/gen_cli_reference.py --check` confirms the CLI reference matches the canonical source.
- [x] Overview help carries the canonical import summary.
- [x] User guidance describes partial results.
- [x] User guidance describes supported serial rerun behavior.
- [x] Guidance promises no whole-file atomicity.
- [x] Guidance promises no automatic completion of partial tickets.
- [x] Concurrent-import limitations are explicit.
- [x] Focused help-generator assertions pass under `python -m pytest tests/unit/test_gen_cli_help.py tests/unit/test_gen_cli_reference.py -q`.
- [x] Focused import-documentation assertions pass under `python -m pytest tests/unit/test_gen_cli_help.py tests/unit/test_gen_cli_reference.py -q`.
- [x] The final diff contains no importer runtime changes.
- [x] Import runtime behavior is unchanged.
